canonical_title: IFM releases K2 Horizon fully open model family
aliases: Institute of Foundation Models K2 Horizon
fully open AI models with training data and checkpoints
organizations: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence
treatment: Treat the six-model K2 Horizon release as covered. Reinclude only for material license or artifact changes, independent reproducibility findings, major benchmark corrections, production adoption, or a subsequent model release.
known_facts: IFM introduced six K2 Horizon foundation models ranging from 0.9B to 375B parameters.
The release includes model weights, code, training data, methodologies, and intermediate checkpoints rather than weights alone.
The artifacts are intended to let researchers inspect and reproduce the development process.
IFM positions the 375B model for enterprise deployments and the smallest model for constrained devices.
The family was announced as available through public model-distribution channels including Hugging Face, Ollama, Unsloth, and IFM's repository.
reinclude_only_if: Independent researchers reproduce or materially challenge the claimed results using the released data and checkpoints.
License, dataset, code, checkpoints, or availability materially changes.
A major production deployment or adoption milestone is announced.
A new K2 Horizon version or materially different model is released.
